blocks.en: Just as sequences of classical functions are central to PDEs, so are sequences of generalized functions.
blocks.zh: 正如经典函数序列在偏微分方程中处于核心地位, 广义函数序列也是如此.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: A sequence $f_n$ in $\mathcal{D}^{\prime}(\Omega)$ \textbf{converges} to $f\in\mathcal{D}^{\prime}(\Omega)$ if \[(f_n,\phi)\to(f,\phi)\] for every $\phi\in\mathcal{D}(\Omega)$.
blocks.zh: 若对每个 $\phi\in\mathcal{D}(\Omega)$ 都有 \[(f_n,\phi)\to(f,\phi)\] 则称 $\mathcal{D}^{\prime}(\Omega)$ 中的序列 $f_n$ \textbf{收敛}到 $f\in\mathcal{D}^{\prime}(\Omega)$.
blocks.label: def:distribution-convergence

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: A uniformly convergent sequence of continuous functions (which define distributions as in Example~\ref{ex:regular-distribution}) also converges in $\mathcal{D}^{\prime}$.
blocks.zh: 连续函数的一致收敛序列 (按 Example~\ref{ex:regular-distribution} 定义分布) 在 $\mathcal{D}^{\prime}$ 中也收敛.
blocks.label: ex:uniform-convergence-distribution

blocks.en: Problem~\ref{ex:compactly-supported-distribution-density} asks the reader to prove that every distribution is the limit of distributions with compact support. Later we shall actually see that every distribution is a limit of test functions; in other words, test functions are dense in $\mathcal{D}^{\prime}(\Omega)$.
blocks.zh: Problem~\ref{ex:compactly-supported-distribution-density} 要求读者证明每个分布都是紧支集分布的极限. 后面实际上将看到, 每个分布都是试验函数的极限; 换言之, 试验函数在 $\mathcal{D}^{\prime}(\Omega)$ 中稠密.
blocks.label: rem:distribution-density

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Another important result is the (sequential) completeness of $\mathcal{D}^{\prime}(\Omega)$.
blocks.zh: 另一个重要结果是 $\mathcal{D}^{\prime}(\Omega)$ 的 (序列) 完备性.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $f_n$ be a sequence in $\mathcal{D}^{\prime}(\Omega)$ such that $(f_n,\phi)$ converges for every $\phi\in\mathcal{D}(\Omega)$. Then there exists $f\in\mathcal{D}^{\prime}(\Omega)$ such that $f_n\to f$.
blocks.zh: 设 $f_n$ 为 $\mathcal{D}^{\prime}(\Omega)$ 中的序列, 使对每个 $\phi\in\mathcal{D}(\Omega)$, $(f_n,\phi)$ 都收敛. 那么存在 $f\in\mathcal{D}^{\prime}(\Omega)$, 使 $f_n\to f$.
blocks.label: thm:distribution-sequential-completeness

blocks.en: Assume that $f_n\to0$ in $\mathcal{D}^{\prime}(\Omega)$ and $\phi_n\to0$ in $\mathcal{D}(\Omega)$. Then $(f_n,\phi_n)\to0$.
blocks.zh: 假设在 $\mathcal{D}^{\prime}(\Omega)$ 中 $f_n\to0$, 且在 $\mathcal{D}(\Omega)$ 中 $\phi_n\to0$. 那么 $(f_n,\phi_n)\to0$.

blocks.en: Hence the pairing between distributions and test functions is continuous. (Of course separate continuity in each factor is obvious from the definitions, but joint continuity requires a proof.)
